provider.name: Meshy
provider.requestUsage: Each preview/refine object is a CLI --data JSON body. For unsubmitted previews also pass that family previewCliFlags, including --pose-mode a-pose. Replace task-ID placeholders with the successful task of that same family before submission.
provider.aiModelPolicy: Remaining previews explicitly pin meshy-7.1 current full-model tier. Actual keeper preview omitted ai_model; keep its submitted payload and record actual resolved provider model later. No evidence-based claim that meshy-6 has superior style.

riggingBoneCount.policy: Informational humanoid expectation only; resolve actual bones/sockets. No fabricated fixed bone-count acceptance.

provider.previewPosePolicy: For every unsubmitted preview pass explicit CLI --pose-mode a-pose in addition to preview.pose_mode=a-pose in --data; do not rely on the CLI auto default or retroactively add flags to the submitted keeper request.

pricing.note: Price verified against official documentation; balance is parent-reported, not checked here. No paid submission performed by this brief task.

sharedDesign.heightMeasurement: Grounded soles to anatomical crown, excluding external headwear, after all runtime scales. Normalize once and compensate any retained look.scale; do not double-multiply height.
sharedDesign.face: Rounded natural anime chin and jaw; no needle chin, angular skull spike, mask hiding the face or photoreal pores.
sharedDesign.sourcePose: Neutral A-pose; arms separated from torso; two arms, two legs, five separate natural digits including one thumb on each palm; forward grounded feet.
sharedDesign.acceptance: All sizes, anatomy, motion and Art scores remain untested until real outputs; target counts are not proof of generated counts.
sharedDesign.headwearException: warp_keeper has a parent-submitted baked cream cloth headwrap. Other families retain separate existing headwear. See actualSubmission; no second preview proposed.
sharedDesign.topologyPolicy: 12k requested target, 16k actual maximum. Do not force a lossy remesh on a <=16k candidate with correct hands/anatomy merely to hit 12k. Actual topology and shipping bytes remain QA targets.

tool_R.rule: Resolve the delivered hand bone and fit to actual palm contact. Preserve existing prop geometry; do not copy a forearm offset blindly onto a wrist.

tool_L.rule: Attach only when requested by this NPC's existing look.props.

basket_L.rule: Do not add a basket to every seller sharing the female supplier body.

headwear.rule: Existing procedural headwear, fitted once to the generated skull; no duplicate baked hat.

apron.rule: Existing smith apron, calibrated to chest and waist.

pack.rule: Existing hunter pack, clear of shoulder and neck motion.

bowl_upper.rule: Preserve current body-mounted monk bowl; no new hand-held bowl animation.
